title: My First Blog Post
text:
In this post, I’ll demonstrate how to create a simple visualization using R.

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Create some sample data
data <- data.frame(
  x = 1:10,
  y = rnorm(10)
)

# Create a plot
ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Sample Plot",
    x = "X axis",
    y = "Y axis"
  )








This is just a simple example of what you can do with R and Quarto. You can include:

Code blocks with syntax highlighting
Mathematical equations
Images and figures
